tagline: A thin bridge between Rust and every platform
brief: Rust framework for cross-platform mobile plugins. Write one Rust trait and get typed Kotlin, Swift and Rust clients from the same source. Executor-agnostic, no serde, no tokio. Audience is Rust and mobile engineers who want cross-platform without giving up native UI.
criteria: Success: distinct from Flutter blue arrow, RN atom, Expo hex, KMP K and Tauri T. Works at 16px as favicon. Works in one color. Does not reuse Rust-orange cliche. Does not reuse Starlight indigo default.

concepts.name: istmo port
concepts.idea: A ring node with two signal leads. The isthmus is the wire that reaches the node.
rationale: Reads as a technical component (resistor, signal node) without copying any competitor
Ring geometry echoes the o in the istmo wordmark — ownership connection
Acid-lime accent on monochrome paper breaks visual tie with Rust-orange cliche and generic SaaS indigo
Scales to 16 px with a small-size cut (thicker leads, slightly thicker ring)
Single idea: node + signal leads = the isthmus is the wire reaching the node

recommendation: istmo port + acid-lime accent + Geist Mono wordmark. Only concept presented after iteration (B1 baseline of ring-with-leads family, chosen by user from 6 variants).
next_steps: Apply mark across Astro docs, GitHub, Penpot pages, README badges
Generate stickers + swag assets if needed
